result.summary: The final r2.1 module remains alive with no paths and acknowledges all four missing feeds. With child ZMQ=1, one camera published 6,000 matching cereal/VisionIPC frame IDs over five minutes on local IPC, with valid nonzero 1,382,400-byte frames and no 9007-9010 TCP listeners. The process exited cleanly, reset all availability fields and removed the local socket. The strict AC-4 cadence threshold fails: mean 19.999396661 fps is below 20.0, maximum EOF gap is 123.185415 ms, and 743 intervals exceeded 60 ms.
